playDataSafety.deletionMechanism: Settings > Privacy > Delete & reset local data immediately clears CARGame first-party local SharedPreferences/recovery state and local diagnostics; no first-party account/backend exists.

encryptedInTransit.basis: Google Mobile Ads current Android data-disclosure guidance states that SDK-transmitted user data is encrypted in transit with TLS; CARGame declares no other network data processor.
